description.value: Mackenzie Co-op is a locally-owned co-operative serving the small northern BC community of Mackenzie, roughly 180 km north of Prince George on Highway 39. As a full-service food store affiliated with Federated Co-operatives, it is one of the primary grocery resupply points for touring cyclists on this remote stretch of northern BC. Membership is not required to shop.
